description: This file defines a PHP interface named Stringable within the OrangeHRM Core Report DisplayField namespace. It declares a single method toString() that returns a nullable string, serving as a contract for classes that need to be represented as strings.
external_files: other files within the OrangeHRM project that implement or use the Stringable interface
